name: Blue Hills Farm Carriere
tagline: Link to Blue Hills Farm Carriere Facebook Page at https://www.facebook.com/Jimbeaux1970/
description: In 259 Joe Smith Rd, MS, Blue Hills Farm Carriere grows Strawberries, Blueberries, Raspberries, Blackberries, and Apples on a working pumpkin patch. The harvest is typically at its peak in summer. The season runs through spring, summer, autumn, and winter. Check the website for current hours and availability.
Seasonal availability typically runs from Mar – Jun in this growing zone.
